title: Trend Rider
briefing: Two companies are in a steady uptrend, but a short pullback is coming. Decide how much to hold and what you will do when prices dip.
objective: Following a trend and sizing positions so a pullback does not break your plan.
debrief: Both stocks rose overall, with a pullback in the middle. Players who stayed invested and kept positions small enough to sit through the dip did best. Selling everything at the low locked in losses just before the trend resumed.
